# WSB User Story Specification and Traceability Baseline

Version 0.1 | 3 November 2026 | Source-derived review draft | Approval withheld.

## Governance and standards basis

Purpose: catalogue the actual test register and repository surfaces, preserve exact test identities, and expose approval gaps. This document is not an ISO certification or an assertion of complete functional coverage. The BDD/user-story format is a project convention; it is not itself prescribed by the cited ISO standards. Full normative clause-by-clause compliance has not been assessed.

Source: [826-case reference sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1hMlC_K52QC87mVSw0puLSqD-1pquvF5SfPP6cGPqeVg/edit#gid=2005382630), retrieved read-only on 3 November 2026. All cases remain Not Run; none was executed for this documentation task. Repository HEAD: d4d79f55ff6e0b83c6238e8d17785d8f04d29dc7, plus current working-tree changes identified by source hashes.

- [ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2018](https://www.iso.org/standard/72089.html): requirements engineering; identifiers, provenance, verifiability and unresolved decisions.
- [ISO/IEC 25010:2023](https://www.iso.org/standard/78176.html): product quality model. The source sheet wording Usability is retained alongside Interaction Capability; the 2011 and 2023 models are not interchangeable.
- [ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119-3:2021](https://standards.ieee.org/ieee/29119-3/7499/): test documentation; preserve inputs, expected outcomes, execution/evidence and trace relationships.

No approved SRS identifier baseline was found. Every REQ-DER identifier is a newly derived tracking reference awaiting WSB governance approval. Existing PAGE/ROUTE/ROLE/F coverage IDs are not approved requirement IDs. Story approval cannot be inferred from case existence. Priority comes from the linked test register; story points have not been estimated.

## Coverage and limits

208 story groups cover all 826 exact spreadsheet case IDs bidirectionally. The source inventory lists 133 page/handler files, 137 Rust route registrations, 179 public Rust model declarations and 733 named executable test symbols. These are static inventory counts, not branch coverage or successful execution.

Groups preserve the test coverage identity and actor. All per-case preconditions, action steps and expected outcomes below come from the supplied register. They are candidate acceptance criteria until checked individually against the cited implementation. Broad source wording is deliberately flagged rather than silently approved. source-inventory.json records source hashes; conditional builds, dynamic imports and durable-mode behavior require additional behavioral review.

## Common authority and quality requirements

Identity errors in apps/api/src/auth.rs: invalid identity=401, invalid target account=422, identity backend unavailable=503. apps/api/src/access.rs derives chapter roles from current server membership, checks active/expiry/auth_time against valid_after, and returns 403 for insufficient role. Crew mutation checks manager ownership. Event access checks assignment with explicit chapter-director exceptions. Public access does not grant mutation authority.

Registration commands carry operation_id; stale expected_revision and changed payload replay can return 409. Actor/chapter-bound receipts and audit writes are transactional in the durable repository. The event/division/crew uniqueness index returns the existing entry for duplicate creation; the universal duplicate-409 claim in the supplied example is not the current contract. See ../persistent-registration.md and apps/api/src/repository/registration.rs. Deadlines, roster evidence, rules version, payment and approval remain distinct checks.

Money uses integer minor units. Public results use separate published projections. Queued offline operations must never be shown as acknowledged submission; locks and conflict resolution remain server-authorized. Do not introduce real identity records, payments, credentials or judge scores into requirements evidence.

Proposed acceptance quality gates: 100% of each story’s linked Then assertions pass; 0 unauthorized mutations/private disclosures in denial cases; 0 duplicate effects in replay cases; 0 serious/critical axe findings plus keyboard review at 320/390/768/1365px for UI cases. These are review targets, not measurements or previously approved SRS requirements. Source-specific numeric thresholds take precedence; the proposed <200ms category-filter target has no implemented baseline.

## Supplied US-EVT-004 conflict review

| Proposed assertion | Actual-source disposition |
|---|---|
| participant role | No such established role; crew_manager, dancer and guardian are separate implemented identities. |
| Street Championship category filter | UpcomingEvents renders a sourced static event card; no category filter there. |
| /login?redirect=... | Actual identity route is /sign-in; inspect auth-return code for its allowed destination contract. |
| POST /api/events/EVT-102/register | No matching route; authoritative registration is chapter-scoped Rust /v1 API. |
| OPEN with capacity >0 | Do not infer this state/capacity model; actual registration-window and division validation must govern. |
| duplicate always 409 | Payload/revision conflicts can be 409; duplicate entry creation may recover the existing entry. |
| TC-DIR-014, TC-DIR-015, TC-RBAC-009 | Absent from the supplied 826-case tab; existing case IDs use WSB prefixes. |
| Approved, REQ-FUNC-018 | User-supplied metadata; repository approval and SRS mapping not established. |

As a public visitor (no chapter role), I want to open / and carry out Home, so that the / interface loads with a meaningful heading or explicit authorized error/unavailable state.

#### WSB-UI-001-01 — Home: render the current interface

Scope: /. Quality mapping: Functional Suitability. Category: Interface / state. Measurable target: all Then assertions below pass; 0 unhandled failures or unauthorized effects. Execution status: Not Run.
Readiness: Ready for local rehearsal. Dependency: None beyond the stated synthetic setup; execution has not occurred.

```gherkin
Scenario: WSB-UI-001-01 Home: render the current interface
  Given Prepare an isolated synthetic fixture for Visitor. Confirm current membership, event assignment and ownership where applicable.
  When Open the route in a clean browser using the appropriate public/account/assignment context.
  And Inspect the page heading, current context, data source and status.
  And Reload and compare the visible record/context.
  Then The / interface loads with a meaningful heading or explicit authorized error/unavailable state.
  And Only current server-backed or clearly labelled static/preview data is displayed.
  And The route retains the intended record and does not turn a reload into a false successful action.
```

The page acknowledges the ballot and disables further voting; after reload, my-ballot returns this judge’s UID and corner red. If this ballot closes the match, the page displays “BATTLE CLOSED · MAJORITY REACHED”.

#### WSB-ROLE-17-01 — Battle judge: allowed action stays in scope

Scope: /console/[eventId]/battles/[matchId]/vote. Quality mapping: Functional Suitability. Category: Role / positive. Measurable target: all Then assertions below pass; 0 unhandled failures or unauthorized effects. Execution status: Not Run.

```gherkin
Scenario: WSB-ROLE-17-01 Battle judge: allowed action stays in scope
  Given In demo-wsb, use a synthetic signed-in judge assigned to the event and listed on an active battle panel; the judge has not cast a ballot. The match must have a nonempty red and blue corner.
  When Open /console/{eventId}/battles/{matchId}/vote as the assigned judge.
  And Select the Red Corner button (“TAP TO VOTE RED”).
  And Observe POST /v1/chapters/{chapter}/events/{eventId}/battles/{matchId}/vote with winner_corner red.
  And Reload the vote page and inspect GET .../my-ballot.
  Then The response contains the same event and match and a red tally of at least 1. The page acknowledges the ballot and disables further voting; after reload, my-ballot returns this judge’s UID and corner red. If this ballot closes the match, the page displays “BATTLE CLOSED · MAJORITY REACHED”.
```
